raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "0d09cbcc869948d5b23e7cbec26417c7::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The party checks provenance and expectations before accepting a package."}, {"item_id": "b8509353366d476e87a653544447e6f9::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Any unrecognized `externalParameters` SHOULD cause verification to fail."}, {"item_id": "5bc1304d1ddd4e08a5c56cc2d76f0089::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Availability threat D is that a package or version is removed from the repository."}, {"item_id": "5bc1304d1ddd4e08a5c56cc2d76f0089::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Availability threat D is that a package or version is temporarily unreachable."}, {"item_id": "ec50dfe2bfd84c768f21a2cc37d96b9d::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "SLSA Build L2 covers tampering of the artifact or provenance."}, {"item_id": "a103885b80294d89851f8e0f850239cb::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "The mitigation here is to compare the provenance against expectations for the package."}, {"item_id": "a103885b80294d89851f8e0f850239cb::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "The mitigation depends on SLSA Build L1 for provenance."}, {"item_id": "78fe2681524b4e47b288ddf167c00174::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The platform authenticates actor identity, timestamp, and parent revisions for changes."}, {"item_id": "fb69357992534284bd576513558d95ed::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Exposure is added by each trusted platform in the supply chain."}, {"item_id": "1764be5d3b8a4d768c8907d4c2ef637a::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "At this level, builds run on a hosted platform."}, {"item_id": "1764be5d3b8a4d768c8907d4c2ef637a::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The hosted platform generates and signs the provenance."}]}
